narr: Isolated flash flooding in southern middle Tennessee.
ev: Six to eight inches of water reported over Damron Road on Winchester Highway. Road is barricaded.
Six to eight inches of water covering Henshaw Road at Winchester Highway. Road is barricaded.
Eight to twelve inches of water covering Wagon Road at Sarvis Branch Road. Water up to the bottom of car doors.
